criterion: Interpret unique territorial candidates outside retained GSHHG land/inland-water classes using existing coast/river/local source evidence and source vintages; source-backed water/location interpretation, without treating mask disagreement alone as rejection. Explicit unresolved questions are not completed physical answers.
method: Human grouped geographic interpretation of existing native RGB/NIR unmarked/centre-marked PNGs and actual centre observations. These lists are substantive review judgments, not a numerical/SCL/WorldCover classifier. No source, raster, transform or native operation was run by the reviewer.

claims.visible_terrestrial_location: The unchanged original centre is located on a visible island or connected coastal terrestrial body in the dated native imagery. The body has legible vegetation/terrain morphology, with local settlement or exposed patches; this does not assert dry understory or a land-cover class at every pixel.
claims.exposed_or_developed_terrestrial_locatio: The unchanged original centre is located on a visible exposed/developed terrestrial surface in the coastal body, supported by the local ground/road/platform morphology on 31 January 2020. This is not a claim about construction approval, reclamation legality or whole-cell coverage.
claims.visible_nearshore_water_location: Water-like surface is visibly present at the unchanged original centre on 31 January 2020, waterward of the depicted island/coastal body. RGB/NIR and surrounding water morphology support this dated nearshore/channel-water location; no annual permanence, depth, salinity or legal maritime category is asserted.
claims.unresolved_native_shore_or_structure: The exact centre falls at a narrow shore, dark margin, small islet tip, developed edge or water-adjacent structure where the native imagery does not separate emerged surface from water/mixed coverage confidently. The locality is visible, but the original emerged-surface versus water question remains unanswered at this exact key.

blocks.setting: Southern end of an elongated vegetated island, surrounded by visibly water-covered channel/coastal space.
Seven centres in the southeastern vegetated coastal tract; surrounding frame contains channels, roads and settlement, but those features are not substituted for the actual seven positions.
Northern narrow island/peninsula shores, southern vegetated small island and coastal settlement/exposed ground. January is locally clearer than December over the southwestern settlement.
Long forested island, a separate slender western islet and a small southern island; several original centres lie visibly waterward of their shores.
716 is on the bright developed coastal platform visible with linear road/building geometry in January;717 is on the small vegetated islet, especially legible in December.
Developed western coastal edge and many separate vegetated islets among water and rectilinear installations. January supplies the clearer surface context; December has substantial local cloud/haze.

scientific_limits: Each answer is date-specific and centre/locality-specific, not full roughly150m-cell emerged land or dry/flood-free ground. Visible canopy can coexist with wet/intertidal ground.
Water appearance does not establish WorldCover annual permanence, salinity, bathymetry, tide level or administrative marine jurisdiction.

SCL and masks are retained observations, not a physical classifier or an automatic veto. Legacy baseline02.13 dark-feature class2 is not automatically cloud shadow. All valid masks do not imply cloud-free content.
December cloud/haze over southwestern blocks is preserved; clear January answers do not imply clear December. A second agreeing date is not required.

Native10m RGB/NIR and20m SCL, mixed shoreline pixels, viewing/display stretch and unestimated registration/shore movement limit exact margins. No tolerance, fitted offset, shoreline extraction or arbitrary threshold was introduced.

The source-purpose assessment supplies2020 Vân Đồn coastal/island context and distinguishes land from sea planning scope. This review does not identify every named original component or infer marine administrative purpose from membership.

No old-parent transition, legal/territorial authority, ownership, constructor qualification, source-parent repair, hold clearance or package completion is accepted. Original intervals with unresolved keys stay partial; root must explicitly adopt any proposed answered keyset before count credit.
